title: Arabic Grammar for Madrasa Students - Beginner Level
summary: This learning material covers basic Arabic grammar concepts for madrasa students, including verbs, nouns, and particles. It includes revision notes, flashcards, key terms, quiz questions, and exercise answers.

revision_notes.heading: Verb (فِعْلٌ)
revision_notes.explanation: A verb is a word that can stand alone and convey meaning without needing another word. It indicates an action and can be in past, present, or future tense. Verbs cannot have tanween or the definite article ال.

examples.note: This is a past tense verb.
This is also a past tense verb.

revision_notes.heading: Particle (حَرْفٌ)
revision_notes.explanation: A particle is a word that cannot convey a complete meaning on its own and requires a noun or a verb to complete its meaning.

examples.note: It needs a noun or verb to complete its meaning.
It also needs a noun or verb to complete its meaning.

revision_notes.heading: Types of Noun (أَقْسَامُ الاسمِ)
revision_notes.explanation: Nouns are categorized into three types: Primary Noun (جَامِدٌ), Root Noun (مَصْدَرٌ), and Derived Noun (مُشْتَقٌّ).

revision_notes.heading: Types of Verb (أَقْسَامُ الفِعْلِ)
revision_notes.explanation: Verbs are categorized into four types: Past tense (المَاضِي), Present and Future tense (المُضَارِعُ), Positive Command (الأَمْرُ), and Negative Command (النَّهْيُ).

examples.english: He is hitting or will hit.
examples.note: A present and future tense verb.

revision_notes.heading: Types of Particle (أَقْسَامُ الحَرْفِ)
revision_notes.explanation: Particles are categorized into two types: Causative Particle (عَامِلٌ) and Non-Causative Particle (عَدِيمُ الْعَامِلِ).

flashcards.back: A verb is a word that can stand alone and convey meaning without needing another word. It indicates an action and can be in past, present, or future tense.
A particle is a word that cannot convey a complete meaning on its own and requires a noun or a verb to complete its meaning.

key_terms.simple_explanation: A word indicating an action, can stand alone.
A word needing a noun or verb to complete its meaning.

quiz.question: Which of the following is a فِعْلٌ?
quiz.explanation: ضَرَبَ is a verb meaning 'He hit', which can stand alone.

quiz.question: A فِعْلٌ can have a تَنْوِينٌ.

exercise_answers.question: State with reason whether the following words are حَرْفٌ or فِعْلٌ ، اِسْمٌ.
exercise_answers.answer:
i. فِعْلٌ (He sat.) iii. اِسْمٌ (girl)
ii. حَرْفٌ (and) iv. فِعْلٌ (He broke.)
exercise_answers.reason: جَلَسَ and كَسَرَ are verbs indicating actions. بِنْتٌ is a noun. وَ is a particle.

exercise_answers.question: Find the meaning and the plural of the following nouns using a dictionary.
exercise_answers.answer:
i. قَلَمٌ: pen, plural أَقْلامٌ
ii. فَصْلٌ: season, plural فُصُولٌ
iii. كِتَابٌ: book, plural كُتُبٌ
iv. سَبُورَةٌ: blackboard, plural سُبُورٌ
exercise_answers.reason: These are common meanings and plurals for the given nouns.

exercise_answers.question: Correct the following words (stating a reason) and give its meaning.
exercise_answers.answer:
i. أَلْبَيْتُ: لَبِثْتُ, meaning 'I stayed'.
ii. أَلْفَتَحُ: أَفْتَحُ, meaning 'I open'.
iii. أَلْوَرَقُ: أَوْرَقَ, meaning 'It became leafy'.
iv. سَمِعَ: Correct as is, meaning 'He heard'.
exercise_answers.reason: The words were corrected to their proper forms and meanings.

exercise_answers.question: Find the meaning and the plural of the following nouns using a dictionary.
exercise_answers.answer:
i. بُسْتَانٌ: garden, plural بُسْتَانَاتٌ
ii. قَمَرٌ: moon, plural أَقْمارٌ
iii. بَابٌ: door, plural أَبْوابٌ
iv. گُلْبُ: Incorrect, likely a typo or non-Arabic word.
exercise_answers.reason: These are common meanings and plurals for the given nouns, except for گُلْبُ which seems incorrect.

exercise_answers.question: Translate the following sentences, and identify the different types of verbs in them.
exercise_answers.answer:
i. حَالِدٌ opened the window. (مَاضِي: فَتَحَ)
ii. Ahmad is studying in the school. (مُضَارِعُ: يَدْرُسُ)
iii. I am writing a letter. (مُضَارِعُ: أَكْتُبُ)
iv. Do not read that book. (نَّهْيُ: لَا تَقْرَأْ)
exercise_answers.reason: The sentences were translated and the types of verbs were identified correctly.
